subject.title: Control UI fails to load on Firefox desktop behind reverse proxy — CSP blocks Vite runtime eval(), 'Control UI did not start', WebSocket 1006

question: Should this issue stay open as a separate Firefox reverse-proxy WebSocket investigation while the shared CSP/Zod eval work remains on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/78362?
rationale: The CSP evidence overlaps a security-sensitive canonical thread, but this issue adds reverse-proxy WebSocket 1006 diagnostics that could require live browser/proxy proof before a gateway behavior change is safe.

options.title: Keep Separate Pending Live Proof
options.body: Keep this issue open for the Firefox reverse-proxy WebSocket failure while the strict-CSP Zod fix is handled through the existing CSP thread.

options.title: Consolidate Under CSP Thread
options.body: Treat the WebSocket failure as likely startup fallout from CSP blocking and close or fold this issue into the existing CSP/Zod issue after preserving the reverse-proxy details there.

options.title: Sponsor CSP Fix First
options.body: Prioritize the strict-CSP Zod fix first, then ask for fresh Firefox reverse-proxy proof only if the WebSocket failure remains after that lands.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Pending Live Proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for the Firefox reverse-proxy WebSocket failure while the strict-CSP Zod fix is handled through the existing CSP thread.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history across the Control UI CSP, browser security boundary, and gateway connection behavior involved in the decision.
